notes.title: Friday-Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36065083/9208d087e7f0ed1eb5f34765f6c69202e4baeb57.png[/img][h1]Update 0.3.1[/h1]

[b]Voice Update[/b]

Our Mask finally has a voice! Your little AI Helper will now help you survive the surreal situation you have woken up to.

We have updated the lighting in caves and the Quest system and extended the Quests.
The player is now able to start different side quests and is not limited to one path of Quests anymore.

We are polishing the map part by part and extending the world with every update. In this update we have reworked the upper portion of the mine.

We hope you enjoy the update :)
